rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00015, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). START FROM iter-7 CHAMPION (c24/ep5/lr2.16e-4, hr 0.8469). ONE KNOB: lr 0.00021567 -> 0.00015 (~0.7x, LOWER). All else = champion exactly (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-7 (c24/ep5/lr2.16e-4): 0.8469=CHAMPION. iter-9 (c24/ep5/lr3.5e-4): 0.8398 -- HIGHER lr slightly REGRESSED (-0.007, overshoot). (2) FAILURE MODE: iter-9's falsifier fired (higher lr worse) -> probe the OTHER direction. The champion lr 2.16e-4 may be near-optimal or want slightly LOWER for a smoother descent that generalizes better on the 200-case val split. (3) ONE KNOB: lr 2.16e-4 -> 1.5e-4 (~0.7x). c/k/epochs/train_n held so any hr change isolates lr direction. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lr=1.5e-4 lifts hr above 0.8469 because a gentler lr avoids the mild overshoot seen at 3.5e-4 and finds a flatter minimum. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8469 at lr=1.5e-4, then lr 2.16e-4 is at the recipe optimum (both 1.5e-4 and 3.5e-4 are worse -> unimodal peak at the seed) -> iter-11 pivots to alpha_init (DC step size) as the last training-recipe lever. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): IDENTICAL config to iter-7 except the lr scalar (no compute change). iter-7=939.5s=15.7min; iter-9 (same config, diff lr) took 1093.9s=18.2min due to node variance -- both < 1200s. max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase so even on a slow node a finite val+figure land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-10 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-11.
